styleLock.direction: clinical premium thin-and-light laptop commerce, cool white stages and anodized metal
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless cool white #F4F5F7 field for figure and deck frames, one near-black slate stage #141B24 reserved for the chip macro, pale card grids #FFFFFF with hairline dividers for feature and inventory screens, warm interior dusk light only inside the single lifestyle frame
styleLock.lightingSystem: sterile even studio light near 6800K, long soft gradient travelling across anodized metal, crisp micro-shadow under each key cap, one teal halo rim on the chip only, warm window sun confined to the lifestyle frame
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte anodized aluminium, black key well with low-relief caps, glass trackpad sheen, frosted chip mirror, smooth white card boards, no wood desk surfaces except the lifestyle frame
styleLock.typography: one calm grotesque in ink #1F2937, every headline, port label, caption and stat slot kept as an empty placeholder
styleLock.iconSystem: thin ink line glyphs (camera, waveform, sound rings) above blank two-line rails, hairline leader lines with flat terminals, no interface screenshots with readable text, no brand marks
styleLock.presentationRules: the laptop screen is always a blank dark glass with no wallpaper or interface, the lid exterior stays unmarked with no logo, ports shown empty, people generic and softened
noDrift: no brand logos on lid or chip
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical premium thin-and-light laptop ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool white field #F4F5F7, deep space blue shell #2E3B4E, starlight silver #E8E6E1 and lake-blue accent #7FA8C9; sterile even studio light near 6800K with a long soft gradient across anodized metal, crisp micro-shadows under key caps and a teal halo reserved for the chip macro; white fields, one near-black slate stage for the chip, pale hairline card grids and warm interior dusk only in the single lifestyle frame; one calm grotesque in ink kept as empty placeholder rails; thin line glyphs above blank rails; blank dark glass screens and unmarked lids; no color palette changes, no readable screen content, no brand logos, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 冷白场开盖正视（屏幕为蓝色放射壁纸，含刘海摄像头）；002 90 度俯拍整版键盘与触控板（键帽字母与 fn/control/command 等字样清晰）；003 四台合盖侧颜堆列（Sky Blue/Silver/Starlight/Midnight 色名黑字）；004 上半 Superscharged by 标题+苹果 M5 芯片镜面（青绿晕光），下半 Up to 18 hours of battery life 与绿色电池图标；005 13.6 英寸 Liquid Retina 与 10 亿色标题，屏内为绿衣骑行人物摄影（含面孔），底部三卡 12MP 摄像头/三麦克风/四扬声器字注；006 上下两条侧边特写，MagSafe/Thunderbolt 4/Headphone jack 引线字注；007 黄昏窗边扶手椅膝上使用实拍（侧脸清晰，屏幕内杂志版面文字可见）；008 四象限：M5 为 AI 而生（屏内设计稿文字）、Apple Intelligence 标语、最高 32GB 统一内存大字、Mac+iPhone 协同（屏内演示文稿与手机聊天长文）；009 What's in the Box：合盖苹果标笔记本+40W 充电头（60W 峰值）+2 米磁吸线字注。品类判定依据：主体为超薄轻金属笔记本电脑，L1 电脑办公、L2 取电脑整机（taxonomy 内笔记本归电脑整机档），leaf 记超薄轻金属便携笔记本电脑；源类目为空，按图判定。已剥离内容：一切品牌与系列字标（苹果标识/M5/MacBook/Air/Apple Intelligence/Mac+iPhone/MagSafe/Thunderbolt）、屏幕壁纸与屏内界面文字（一律改空白暗屏）、键帽字母、四色色名、18 小时/32GB/40W/60W/2 米/13.6 英寸/12MP/10 亿色数字、全部英文标题原句、实拍人物面孔，改为空标签轨/空数字块/{selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位。与同轮靛蓝彩色本任务（另一代理/后续处理）区分：本套为深宇蓝金属冷白临床场+黑场芯片微距骨架。源图 9 张，逐图一镜排为 9 镜。
